patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct swing highs are visible near the 1840-1850 zone with an intervening swing low around 1780-1790. Price has declined from the second peak and is currently retesting the neckline area near 1800-1810.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price rallied from a low near 1720 to resistance around 1840-1850, pulled back to approximately 1780-1790, rallied again to similar highs, and is now declining toward the prior low zone. This structure resembles a developing double top.
limitations: 15m timeframe noise may invalidate the pattern prematurely
Pattern remains unconfirmed until neckline break occurs
Latest candle may still be forming and could alter the structure
